data.body: Reproduced on a store copy at origin/main ca6810a4: one inbound scan for d70a-97d9 opens 141,085 files, 609.5 MB. Confirmed by reading _replay.py that only CREATE/EDIT/LINK/UNLINK/SNAPSHOT change parent_id or deps (REVERT acts only on ARCHIVED). Plan refined: exclude -PRECONDITIONS-SNAPSHOT.json (shares the -SNAPSHOT.json suffix, never replayed), name the test module, and define the 50-ticket comparison as the old all-files candidate scan versus the new one.
